description.en: A cinematic React hero section where a muted looping video fills 100vw x 100vh as a background and the user controls playback through scroll. description.en:

**Testing & metrics:** Measure scrubbing latency, chapter load times, chapter drop-off rate. Test on desktop and mobile across varied network profiles.
